# Routing decision fixtures for x20-route-core.decide().
# Columns (whitespace separated, "-" = unset):
#   case-name  node_name  explicit  default-sink  sinks  expected
# sinks: comma list of name:priority:form-factor:route:available, where route
# is a shorthand expanded by tests/lua/test_x20_route_core.lua:
#   hp    "[Out] Headphones"         (UCM, the X20 jack)
#   spk   "[Out] Speaker"            (UCM, the X20 speakers)
#   acphp "analog-output-headphones" (ACP, description "Headphones")
#   hdmi  "hdmi-output-0"
#   -     no route (virtual sink, Bluetooth, USB without routes)
# The X20 internal card: jack sink "jack" at 1000, speaker sink "spk" at 712
# (measured); our sinks at 50 (headphone surround) and 750/740 (speakers).
# Expected "nil" = leave to WirePlumber (the default sink), "unlinked" = stay
# unlinked (no fallback).

# --- application streams are never routed: they follow the default sink
app-stream-follows-default               game                            no   x20-speakers             jack:1000:-:hp:no,spk:712:-:spk:unknown,x20-speakers:750:-:-:-                                   nil
app-stream-default-hrtf-sink             game                            no   x20-virtual-surround-71  jack:1000:-:hp:yes,spk:712:-:spk:unknown,x20-virtual-surround-71:50:-:-:-                         nil
app-surround-stream-on-speakers          game-7.1                        no   spk                      jack:1000:-:hp:no,spk:712:-:spk:unknown                                                          nil

# --- the bug: jack unavailable, x20-speakers default. x20-speakers.output is
# pinned in its conf (explicit target), so the hook leaves it alone, and it
# never falls back to the highest-priority sink (the unplugged jack).
speakers-output-pinned-jack-unavailable  x20-speakers.output             yes  x20-speakers             jack:1000:-:hp:no,spk:712:-:spk:unknown,x20-speakers:750:-:-:-                                   nil
speakers-output-unpinned-no-rule         x20-speakers.output             no   x20-speakers             jack:1000:-:hp:no,spk:712:-:spk:unknown,x20-speakers:750:-:-:-                                   nil
surround-output-follows-its-target       x20-speakers-surround.output    yes  x20-speakers-surround    jack:1000:-:hp:no,spk:712:-:spk:unknown,x20-speakers:740:-:-:-,x20-speakers-surround:750:-:-:-  nil
